note: Corrects this file's own prior note, which characterized an observed flake as environment cold-start without finding its real cause. The real cause (found wiring FT-02's identical review card, see FT-02.json): fit-tools.spec.ts called page.reload() immediately after .click(), which resolves once the click dispatches, not once the mutation's underlying fetch completes — an occasionally-fast reload raced the write and reloaded the pre-decision page. Fixed by waiting for the mutating response before reloading. 30 repeated runs across fit-tools.spec.ts, silhouette-analysis-review.spec.ts and advisor-capture.spec.ts (same page) afterward: all clean, including the specific scenario that had intermittently failed before. Two auto-refresh approaches (redirect() to the same path; explicit client-side router.refresh()) were tried first and both confirmed unreliable by repeated real-browser runs before the actual test-side race was found; neither is used in the final code. Full retailer lint/typecheck clean. Deferred, named honestly: real advisor fit-comparison rendering against the previous approved fit, customer-side capture, supplier write-back.
